_comment: Pass lines are per index. A pass line measured on one index says nothing about another: the corpora differ in what they contain, so the population differs. v8b -- an earlier, less complete index than v9. It does carry item-level (号) and sub-item chunks and many branch-numbered articles; the difference from v9 is coverage completeness -- v9 indexes more articles across more laws (e.g. fuller 医薬品医療機器等法 / 金融商品取引法 coverage) -- not the presence or absence of the 号/sub-item/branch layers. A few specific branch-numbered articles (e.g. the previously-cited 132-2) are absent from v8b. Its numbers are a historical baseline, now scored on the same full ground-truth denominator as v9 (a gold article absent from this index scores 0, not dropped). v9 -- item and sub-item text is first-class; branch-numbered articles are present; the fidelity gates pass with zero violations, and honbun is scored on the full ground-truth denominator with no cross-filter (a gold article absent from the index scores 0, not dropped). The new-layer pass lines (taxanswer, tsutatsu) are likewise scored on the full denominator with no index filter, so a gold chunk absent from the index scores 0; a count below the question total reflects a source gap surfaced, not a regression. This file is anchored by an out-of-repo digest (see tools/scripts/verify-gates-lock.py); values here are owner-locked baselines and must not be edited to make a run pass.

v0.2-aug-v8b-gemini.note: an earlier, less complete index than v9; re-scored on the same full ground-truth denominator with no cross-filter (a gold absent from this index scores 0, not dropped).

v0.2-aug-v9-gemini.note: v9 honbun is measured on the full ground-truth denominator: every honbun question whose gold article the eval specifies is scored, with no cross-filter against either an older corpus or this index. A question whose gold article is absent from the index scores 0 (a miss) rather than being dropped. Any decrease from the earlier provisional 78/97 reflects (a) branch-numbered questions now included and (b) index-missing gold now counted as 0 — the visualization of gaps the previous filter hid, not a regression. The pass line detects drift against this fixed, honest population.
